scope: These fixed snapshots prove legality and only the stated local preference. They are not a benchmark or claim of general strategic strength.

fixtures.title: Purchase an affordable unowned estate
fixtures.boundedReasonableness: In this snapshot the purchase is affordable and leaves more than 1,000 cash; only that local reserve fact is asserted.

fixtures.title: Open an auction at the exact minimum bid
fixtures.boundedReasonableness: The bid is the current minimum and is affordable in this snapshot; no future-value claim is made.

fixtures.title: Use an already held exit card
fixtures.boundedReasonableness: The actor has the matching card and this choice preserves the fixture's cash; it is not a universal jail policy.

fixtures.title: Open a house-building window for a complete group
fixtures.boundedReasonableness: The actor owns the complete undeveloped group, has ample cash and the bank has stock; no portfolio-wide optimum is claimed.

fixtures.title: Open a draft with the only other active participant
fixtures.boundedReasonableness: This proves only that starting a reversible draft with the sole peer is legal; it does not rate an eventual offer.

fixtures.title: Create liquidity from an eligible unmortgaged asset
fixtures.boundedReasonableness: The actor cannot yet pay and this exact asset is eligible collateral; no ordering claim among multiple assets is made.

fixtures.title: Declare bankruptcy with the actor's exact two held cards
fixtures.boundedReasonableness: The actor has insufficient cash and no remaining building, sale or mortgage liquidity; this is a terminal fixture fact, not strategy advice.
